svg.title: The ray bench: P1, P2 and P9, measured
svg.desc: Top: the 4 KB height grid and a ray walking its cells toward the sun, with the cost model C_ray = C_setup + n C_step: predicted 12 to 16 a step and 30 a setup, measured 22.1 and about 72. Below, three panels: P1 cycles a ray against n, measured points on a zero grid and the town grid with their fit line above the old predicted band; P2 the slice batched, interleaved with the vertex transform, and with the grid in OC-RAM, with measured cycles a ray; P9 the movers proxy pass, 312 microseconds against a 2 ms slice. Foot: what the run changes. One console, one run, 2026-11-25.
svg.text: The ray bench: three predictions, run on a console
RUN: MEASURED, one console, 2026-11-25, one run. Image psm-bench-ray1. Kernel bytes the same as the reference on every page.
Read from photos PXL_20261125_*: demo/psm/bench/RAY1_RESULTS_cortana.md and RAY1_RESULTS_junior.md. THESIS §6 P1, P2, P9; h3.
Status: MEASURED our console · FACT a manual or our code · ESTIMATE our arithmetic or model · OPEN not known
What is timed: a ray walking a 4 KB height grid toward the sun (thesis §5.3)
64 x 64 cells, 1 B a cell (tallest caster,
4 KB = 128 of the 512 lines of the 16 KB
A step: advance to the next x or z wall,
compare the cell's height with the ray's.
Stop at a hit, above H, or at the edge.

The pass against a 2 ms slice
too low. 15.6 % of 2 ms; 741 rays fit beside
Load places only; box proxy not in this image.
P1: every §5 cycle count built on 12 .. 16 a step and 30 a setup is low; the slice k and the refresh period P = N / (k f) need redoing.
P2: run the slice batched, before the transform; interleaving costs 16 .. 21 % more a ray. Keep the grid in RAM: OC-RAM's halved cache costs more.
P9: the movers' proxies fit beside one slice. h3: mat_transform 13.38 / 42.86 cycles in / out of the cache, the DCE batch 14.15 / 45.99:
no measured gain for the batch [MEASURED]; whether it stays is the owner's call.
One console, one run. Stand-ins: random receivers, not the town's vertices; a synthetic 28,699-vertex stream.
No ns figure from ray1 goes in the ledger until P1.4 is repeated.
